children.text: Workshop 02: Mastering Unit Economics

A great idea needs to make financial sense. Workshop 02 of IEEE Innovation Nation Sri Lanka 2026 is designed to help university innovators understand the financial fundamentals behind their ideas and make informed business decisions.

Led by Mr. Chaminda Amarasekera, Director of Synergy by Y & C, the session will cover practical concepts including pricing, costs, profit margins, and unit economics, helping participants evaluate the financial potential of their ideas.
Date: 16th September 2026
Time: 8:00 PM onwards
Platform: Zoom
Join us to explore the numbers behind your idea, strengthen your business thinking, and take your idea one step further. 📊

children.text: Workshop 01: How to Pitch to Investors Like a Pro

A great idea needs a great pitch. Workshop 01 of IEEE Innovation Nation Sri Lanka 2026 is designed to help early-stage university entrepreneurs learn how to structure, communicate, and deliver a compelling pitch to investors.

Led by Mr. Shaun Zelber, CEO of Beyond Technologies, the session will cover practical approaches to telling a clear problem-solution story, highlighting market opportunities and traction, and avoiding common mistakes when pitching to investors.
Date: 2nd September 2026
Time: 7:30 PM onwards
Platform: Zoom
Join us to sharpen your pitch, communicate your ideas with confidence, and learn what it takes to make an impact on investors. 🚀

children.text: How to Convert Your Business Idea into a Pitch Deck

Turning a business idea into a compelling pitch deck is a crucial step in securing funding and gaining stakeholder interest. Provincial Workshop 02, titled “How to Convert Your Business Idea into a Pitch Deck”, is a high-impact hybrid session designed to help aspiring entrepreneurs and innovators effectively communicate their vision.

This workshop will be led by Mr. Heminda Jayaweera, Executive Director at TRACE Sri Lanka, a prominent figure in the startup ecosystem with a wealth of experience in guiding founders through the early stages of venture building. In this session, he will share expert insights into structuring an impactful pitch, highlighting investor-relevant metrics, and storytelling techniques to captivate your audience.
📅 Date: 3rd May 2025
🕚 Time: 11:00 AM
🌐 Platform: Hybrid (Online & In-person)
Whether you’re preparing for your first investor meeting or refining your existing pitch, this workshop will equip you with the tools and confidence to deliver a pitch deck that resonates.
